verdict.rationale: kitty's automations live in user-authored artifacts: kitty.conf, Python kittens and startup session files. Its documented git integration and kitty-diff could support reviewing changes to those files. That makes versioning possible only through external tools like git; the evidence shows no built-in versioning, history, review workflow or rollback for automations. Missing for 10: native automation version history, a review/approval flow, one-step rollback, and any documentation or hands-on evidence of versioning automations specifically.
